meta.title: Sources
meta.note: Every source consulted this session, classified by type. 'Official government' = federal/state/county agencies. 'Code publisher' = IAPMO (publishes the UPC/CPC) or complete code reprints. 'Manufacturer' = the manufacturer's own documentation. All other sources are third-party and labeled as such. Each URL was fetched and read during this session (2026-11-06) unless noted.

sources.title: CSLB — Find A Licensed Contractor (multi-trade B vs C classification guidance)
sources.used_for: Official explanation: a B contractor is appropriate when a job requires more than two types of work; B cannot contract single-trade jobs; C-36 is the plumbing specialty classification

sources.title: IAPMO — Answers and Analysis, UPC Chapter 4 (Section 402.10 Slip Joint Connections)
sources.used_for: Official code-publisher interpretation: fixtures with concealed slip-joint connections need an access panel or utility space >= 12 inches in least dimension

sources.title: California Plumbing Code 2022, Section 402.10 Slip Joint Connections (UpCodes reprint)
sources.used_for: CPC 2022 text of the access-panel requirement

sources.title: 2010 California Plumbing Code, Chapter 4 (Section 404.2 Connections — access panel >= 12 in)
sources.used_for: State-published CPC text showing the same access requirement (edition numbering differs: 404.2 in 2010 vs 402.10 in 2022)

sources.title: IAPMO / CPC — Bathtub waste arrangement & overflows (CPC 404.2.1: standing water must not rise in overflow when stopper closed)
sources.used_for: Overflow/waste arrangement requirement relevant to trip-lever/plunger function

sources.title: Bathtub Waste Outlets and Overflows (IPC P2713.1 / CPC 407.2 equivalents)
sources.used_for: Waste outlet >= 1-1/2 in with watertight stopper; overflow >= 1-1/2 in where installed

sources.title: HomeGuide — Bathtub Repair Cost (2026)

sources.title: Angi — Bathroom Leak Repair Cost (Oct 2026)
sources.used_for: Benchmarks: tub drain replacement ~$700 (easy access), $500–$1,025 (difficult access); drywall patching adds $300–$930

sources.title: r/Plumbing — 'Stuck trip lever, old bathtub' thread (2023)
